description:
COPAIBA mari-mari is a social cosmetics brand born from NPO initiatives in the Amazon rainforest. Since 2001, we have created skin and oral care products with natural copaiba resin. A portion of our proceeds supports education and economic independence for local Amazonian communities. In 1992, the United Nations Conference on Environment and Development—widely known as the Earth Summit—was held in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.

Our founder, Akira Yoshino, attended the international conference as the head of a Japanese NGO dedicated to supporting remote communities in the Amazon rainforest.

Far from the cities, people living deep within the Amazon faced many challenges in their daily lives—from limited access to healthcare and basic infrastructure to a lack of educational and employment opportunities.

Yoshino moved to a local community in the Amazon with his family. Over the next five years, he worked alongside local people to establish schools and create opportunities for employment.

During his time there, he witnessed how Indigenous communities had passed down generations of knowledge about the plants native to the Amazon, drawing on their natural benefits to nurture health, well-being, and beauty.

Yoshino himself was one of those who experienced the restorative power of these plants firsthand.

That experience became the beginning of COPAIBA mari-mari.

In 2001, the brand was founded around the natural oleoresin harvested from wild copaiba trees in the Amazon rainforest. Rooted in fair trade, COPAIBA mari-mari began its journey as a skin and inner-care brand devoted to bringing out the skin’s natural vitality.

Because what touches your skin should be gentle, pure, and true.

A portion of our proceeds supports educational initiatives in the Amazon, helping preserve and carry forward the connection between people and nature for generations to come.
